canonical_name: No Data and Metadata Inventory Maintained
description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata are not maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of data catalogs, missing data classification inventories, lack of metadata management, or gaps in data asset documentation. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include sensitive data locations, data types, data owners, retention requirements, and processing activities for compliance with privacy and data protection regulations.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
